intro: Alongside my research in mathematics, I work on applied problems involving statistical learning and networks. I received an MS in Data Science from the University of Delaware in 2023.

projects.title: Hitmakers vs. One-Hit Wonders
projects.award: First place · Erdős Institute Data Science Project Competition
projects.collaborators: James McNally, Yundi Kong, and Guillermo Sanmarco
paragraphs: Can an artist’s first top-20 hit help predict whether they will have another? Our team used chart history, genre information, and collaboration networks to study sustained success in the music industry.
We compared Random Forest, XGBoost, and CatBoost models, with cross-validation and probability calibration.
